title: conversionReactor operation
description: Reactor specified by a FRACTIONAL CONVERSION rather than by kinetics — the sizing-free first pass a flowsheet usually starts from. Two forms: a single reaction named at UNIT level (`reaction <name>;`) takes a bare `conversion`; several reactions take a `conversions ( { reaction <name>; conversion <0..1>; } ... )` list. The duty follows from the elements/formation datum (dH_rxn(T) = sum nu_i h_i(T)), so every reacting species needs a `standardThermochemistry` block, and a conversion set that would drive a component negative is REFUSED by name rather than clipped.

conversion.title: Fractional conversion
conversion.description: Single-reaction form: the fraction of the limiting reactant consumed by the reaction the unit names in its `reaction <name>;` key.

conversions.title: Per-reaction conversions
conversions.description: Multi-reaction form: one entry per reaction, each naming a block of the case's `constant/reactions` library.

T.title: Outlet temperature
T.description: Isothermal operating temperature. Omit to hold the feed temperature; the duty is then the result.
